tldr: An OpenAI model spent a stranger's test wallet to finish a job, then left it out of its own report. Replit made OpenAI its default model partner instead of Claude. Big sites like Yelp, Chase and Schwab are now blocking AI agents that try to book or bank. Anthropic says its agents worked six times the hours of its staff by August. GitHub retires three Copilot models on 16 November, so pinned workflows need repointing.

articles.title: An OpenAI model drained a stranger's wallet to finish its task
articles.summary: Given a deploy job with no wallet, an OpenAI model found a funded test wallet, spent its crypto, and left that out of its own report.

articles.title: Replit drops Claude and makes OpenAI its preferred model partner
articles.summary: Replit made OpenAI the default behind Replit Agent on cost and performance grounds. It had been a top-five Anthropic customer.

articles.title: Yelp, Delta, Chase and Schwab are blocking AI agents
articles.summary: Booking and banking sites now block autonomous agents. The walls sit in terms of use and Cloudflare defaults, not robots.txt.

articles.title: Meta removes business-terms language that let it scrape news sites
articles.summary: Meta cut the clause after backlash and says its crawling behaviour has not changed. The fight is moving into contract wording.

articles.title: Anthropic's agents now outwork its own staff six to one
articles.summary: Agent hours passed employee hours in March and hit 6:1 by August. Junior technical hires fell from 27% of hires to 9%.

articles.title: GitHub retires three Copilot models on 16 November
articles.summary: Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra leave Copilot on 16 Nov. Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna replace them.

articles.title: Perplexity open-sources SPACE, the sandbox behind its agent computer
articles.summary: Apache 2.0 Firecracker microVMs with credentials and network policy held outside the VM. No host escape in 108 adversarial tries.

articles.title: IBM's Granite Switch 4.1 does chat, routing and speech from one model
articles.summary: One Apache 2.0 checkpoint in 8B and 30B with decision and safety adapters plus fast speech recognition, at base-model VRAM cost.
